title: Sealed Admin Change‑Proof Connector and Retention Simulator
creator: Sofia Ramos
description: Build a hardened connector that captures admin actions (RBAC changes, config updates, access grants), signs records with a customer-scoped HSM key, and writes append-only manifests to a WORM-backed evidence store. Include a retention policy simulator that models regional residency rules and retention holds before export, and automation to generate compliant export bundles for legal/aml/incident workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Connector captures admin actions from Console and Control Plane with structured fields (actor, action, resource, before/after, timestamp, region)
Each event is signed with an HSM-protected key or KMS envelope; signature and chain metadata stored with event
Events are written atomically into an append-only WORM store (S3 Object Lock or on-prem sealed store) with integrity metadata and manifest indexing
Retention simulator can run policy scenarios per-customer and per-region and produce a timeline of deletion eligibility and legal hold overlays
Automated evidence export can produce a notarized bundle (signed manifests + chunked objects + checksum catalog) and a human-readable report suitable for compliance teams
End-to-end tests demonstrate tamper-evidence (changed event -> signature mismatch) and residency policy enforcement in the simulator
tasks: Design event schema and canonical field set for admin actions (include JSON Schema draft)
Integrate with Console audit hooks and control-plane change-log stream (Kafka topic: admin-audit.events)
Add signer stub that supports both AWS KMS and on-prem HSM workflows (CAPI + integration tests)
Implement WORM writer: S3 Object Lock + multipart commit pattern and fallback path for private deployments
Build retention policy simulator service with scenario input and timeline visualization (prototype front-end in Console)
Create evidence export format and CLI tool for secure handoff (checksums, signatures, manifest index)
Author automated CI tests for signature verification, object immutability checks, and retention rule simulation
Document runbook for incident response and legal export request flow
decision_log: 2025-01-14: Chose canonical event schema that embeds 'region' and 'residency_tag' for policy enforcement. Rationale: simplifies simulator mapping and per-object retention headers.

2025-01-22: Opted to use S3 Object Lock for hosted and a sealed-store adapter for Private (on-prem) deployments. Trade-off: Object Lock is simpler for hosted but requires adapter work for customers with air-gapped infra.
2025-02-03: Signatures will be HMAC for low-latency cases and RSA/ECDSA via KMS/HSM for legal-grade evidence. HMAC retained in an envelope with public key metadata for verification.
2025-02-10: Export bundle format v1 decided: tar.gz of chunks + manifest.jsonl (signed) + public key cert chain. Allows offline verification and forensic rehydration.
implementation_notes: Producer will publish to admin-audit.events Kafka topic with partitioning by customer_id and region to preserve ordering where possible
Writer service must observe eventual consistency windows when modeling retention; simulator will accept a max-lag parameter to emulate cross-region replication delays
Ensure manifest indexing supports time-range and resource-based queries without scanning full object set (secondary index in DynamoDB or RocksDB local index) for fast exports
Add metrics: events_captured_total, signature_failures_total, worm_write_errors, export_bundle_latency
For private deployments, provide an operator tool to rotate signing keys and re-certify previously-exported bundles
risks: Key management complexity across hosted/dedicated/private (HSM vs KMS). Mitigation: unified signer interface and strong devdocs
Retention simulation may diverge from live behavior due to replication lag and policy edge cases. Mitigation: allow simulator to consume sampled real events for validation
Export bundles containing PII must be carefully access-controlled. Mitigation: require requester SSO + approval workflow and encrypt export at rest with customer key
